name: Virgo
description: Virgo: KSN's own AI assistant for chat and voice in English and Khmer, built on open models (Gemma 4) and tuned to Virgo's voice.

chat.Angkor-2.0: fast everyday chat and live voice (Gemma 4 26B A4B)
chat.Bayon-2.0: the deeper thinker, loaded on demand (Gemma 4 31B)

components.voice: Bakong-2.0: spoken answers in Khmer and English (VoxCPM2)
components.hearing: speech to text in Khmer and English (Angkor-1.0-STT, Whisper)
components.realtime: live voice conversation: listen, answer with Angkor-2.0, speak sentence by sentence
